title: SkillStateChangedData
description: data of skill.state_changed (registry 1.4.0, ADR-0034, FR-SKL-04, FR-SKL-06): the owner saved a draft (it starts as learning), marked the skill trusted, set it back to learning, paused it or resumed it. A trusted change records the good runs and the threshold in force (good_runs >= threshold, TS-08). The owner is the actor, and the record is written before the event. Envelope as TS-11.
